theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_normalAverage_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, ‖reducedNormal μ ν x‖ = 1 ∧ (∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ Metric.ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₀, 0 < μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ∧ (μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal ≤ 2 * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) (reducedNormal μ ν x) ∂μ) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (C ρ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ρ₂ → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₂, μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, ‖ν y - reducedNormal μ ν x‖ ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
